turns.text: Okay so for this exercise we have a small project set up already.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: There is a local API running with Django REST Framework and it serves departures.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: The departures endpoint is paginated and each page gives you a next link.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: So what I want you to build is a script that walks every page, collects all the departures, keeps only the ones with a start date after June first 2018 in the Adventurous category, and writes them to a CSV with title-case headers. How would you structure that?
